title: Longest Sunny Streak
statement: A weather log is a string of letters, one per day: 'S' for sunny and 'R' for rainy. Return the length of the longest run of consecutive sunny days.

answerKey.pattern: Single scan with a current run length and a best run length
keyPoints: Keep two numbers: the current run and the best run
On 'S' add 1 to the current run and update the best
On 'R' reset the current run to 0
edgeCases: The longest run is at the very end
acceptableSlowerApproaches: For every start day, count forward: O(n^2)

hints: Starting a new count from every day repeats work. What can you carry from one day to the next?
Track the length of the current sunny run and the best length seen so far.
Update the best on every sunny day, so a run that ends the log is not missed.
